units: Gen. XXX, 41, sq.] to join, knot, tie; to fold.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> <he>הקוֹשֵׁר והמתיר</he> he that makes a knot or unties it. Y. ib. 10ᶜ <he>שהיו קוֹשְׁרִין וכ׳</he> they knotted the ropes (of the Tabernacle). Ib. <he>נפסק היה קוֹשְׁרוֹ</he> when a thread was broken (in weaving), one knotted it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 8:10:4">Y. Gitt. VIII, end, 49ᵈ</cite> <he>אפי׳ קושר וכ׳</he> even if he folds (the document) up, and then has it signed.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 8:10:4">Ib.</cite> <he>בשׁקְשָׁרוֹ וחתמו וכ׳</he> when he folded it and had it signed inside; a. fr.—Trnsf.

senses.gloss: (cmp. חָרַז) to compose and arrange (a funeral song or eulogy).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:8">Y. Yoma I, 38ᵇ</cite> <he>קָשְׁרוּ הספידו</he> they arranged his eulogy. Lam. R. introd. (R. Joḥ. 1), v. <cite ref="M01986"><he>מִסְפֵּד</he></cite>; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: conceive, form an affection. Pesik. B’shallaḥ, p. 80ᵃ הוא קושר לו אהבה וכ׳ he acquires love and affection for him; Gen. R. s. 54; Yalk. Prov. 954; a. e.—Part. pass. קָשׁוּר; f. קְשׁוּרָה &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 1:3:7">Y. Nidd. I, 49ᵇ</cite> top <he>אילו יהושע שהיה ק׳ למשה וכ׳</he> a Joshua who was tied to Moses (his constant attendant) could not have spoken so (that Moses had not said a certain thing), and he says so (of R. Jeremiah)? <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 2:1">Erub. II, 1</cite> <he>קְשׁוּרוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="N01392"><he>נָתַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 16:4:2">Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᵈ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="E00709"><he>הֶסְפֵּד</he></cite>; a. e.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: same, esp. to fold a document, to write a portion and fold it and have witnesses signed on the fold, and so continue to the end of the document. Y. Gitt. l. c. היה מְקַשֵּׁר ראשון ראשון if he folded up the signatures one by one; a. e.—Part. pass. מְקוּשָּׁר. מק׳ (גט) a folded document, opp. פָּשׁוּט.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:1">B. Bath. X, 1</cite> <he>גט פשוט … ומק׳ עדיו אחוריו</he> a plain document has its signatures of witnesses inside, a folded one, on its back.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 160a">Ib. 160ᵃ</cite> sq. (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 32:44">Jer. XXXII, 44</cite>) <he>וכתוב … וחתום זה מק׳</he> ‘and write the deed’, this refers to the plain document, ‘and sign’, this means the folded document; Y. ib. X, beg. 17ᶜ (ref. to Jer. ib. 11) <he>את החתום זה המק׳ ואת הגלוי זה הפשוט שבמק׳</he> ‘the sealed’ means the folded, ‘and the open’ means the plain document which goes with the folded. Ib. bot. <he>טופס שטרות מְקוּשָּׁרוֹת וכ׳</he> such is the formula of folded documents; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:15">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>כלב נ׳</he> the dog was doomed to be tied.

Shebi. III, 1 משׁיִקָּשֵׁר (Mish. ed. משיקשור, incorr.) when the mathoḳ (v. מָתוֹק II) gets knotty excrescences; (R. S.: when the dung in its juice becomes bound, begins to harden); expl. Y. ib. 34ᶜ top משיעשה קשרין קשרין when it gets full of knotty excrescences; ib. מכיון שנקשר בו קשר וכ׳ R. S. to Shebi. l. c. (ed. שנִתְקַשֵּׁר) as soon as the uppermost protuberance is formed, it begins to dry up.

senses.gloss: same, to become knotty; to become thick. Y. Shebi. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 20a:2">Taan. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>נִתְקַשְּׁרוּ שמים וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00008"><he>עָב</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>יוּקְשְׁרוּ כולם אגודה וכ׳</he> let all of them be tied together with one band (of brotherhood; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 651:12">Yalk. ib. 651</cite> <he>יֵעָשׂוּ כולן וכ׳</he>).
